about_the_game:
Your life takes an unexpected turn when, after (accidentally) agreeing to the terms of a mysterious contract, you end up living with Mika Nyanami — a mischievous alien catgirl sent by the Multispecies Preservation Alliance to carry out a... reproductive mission.

Now, you'll have to spend several days with her under evaluation, completing strange objectives like maintaining her levels of socialization, nutrition, hygiene, entertainment... and intimacy.
If you fail, the Alliance may deem your planet unfit for preservation...

And as if that weren’t enough, you'll also have to deal with a government agent who suspects you’re hiding an alien entity at home.

Key Features

😺 An adorable and cheeky alien guest you'll be living with.
🧼 Choose where to work, come back home, interact with Mika, clean, cook, or play.
🧪 Mysterious goals imposed by an alien AI.
🎮 Unlockable scenes, from everyday moments to suggestive situations.
🔥 NSFW content included.
🛸 A story that blends comedy, eroticism, and sci-fi.

Objective

Keep Mika’s emotional and physical levels stable to pass the evaluation.
If you succeed, she might get to stay with you forever...
But if you fail, the Alliance has its own methods to shut down the project.

Multiple endings available.
